cars.variant: Lotus Carlton — original UK road saloon
cars.specification_market: Original UK Vauxhall Lotus Carlton, the same Type 104 programme called Lotus Omega outside the UK. Only one record covers those aliases. Vauxhall’s own collection/history release supplies 3615 cc, twin Garrett T25 units, intercoolers and chassis. Lotus separately supports the six-speed manual. Do not import base Carlton GSi, Opel-branded duplicate, modified high-output examples or undefined mass. cars.specification_market: UK October 1979 Series 1 road Sunbeam Lotus, original brochure C9579/1/20. Technical table on PDF page 6 supplies 2172 cc and road equipment. Four valves per cylinder is derived from four cylinders and sixteen valves. The current Lotus history table incorrectly says 1588 cc; that field is rejected. Its narrative’s 2.2-litre identity and the 1981 manufacturers’ championship support the history only. Race output near 250 bhp, later Series 2 details and special Essex colours are excluded. Native DIN bhp is not relabelled as metric PS or converted to modern net kW.
cars.summary: The Sunbeam Lotus combined a compact road hatchback with a specially developed Lotus twin-cam engine and became the production basis of Talbot’s world-championship rally programme, giving it significance beyond an ordinary sporting trim.
